name: Myson Century, Inc.
summary: Myson Century, Inc., together with its subsidiaries and designs, manufacturers, and sells integrated circuit systems in Taiwan, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company engages in the provision of safety monitoring products; restaurant business; retail of food and grocery; retail of beverages; other catering businesses; trading of building materials; interior decoration business; trading of clothing; advertising and marketing business; insurance brokerage; and the manufacture and sale of connecting cables and computer typewriters. Myson Century, Inc. was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.
